1	# Epic 3 Context: Multimodal Capture & Processing
2	
3	<!-- Compiled from planning artifacts. Edit freely. Regenerate with compile-epic-context if planning docs change. -->
4	
5	## Goal
6	
7	Users capture a journal Entry through one shared Insertion Modal in three ways — typed text, recorded audio, or a photo — and every modality ends up as the same persisted `Entry` shape. Audio is transcribed entirely on-device; a photo's text is recognized server-side via OCR before the Entry exists. Text and audio/photo stay merged into one epic because an un-transcribed audio Entry or un-OCR'd photo Entry is not a usable product outcome on its own — "capture" and "process" are one milestone here, not two. The epic also guarantees interrupting any capture (switching tabs, backing out, stopping early) never leaves a stray partial or empty Entry behind. This is the first epic to introduce `features/entries/`, which every later epic that creates or reads an Entry (Timeline, Search, Chat save-to-journal) will consume through its port — so decisions made here about that port's shape are load-bearing for the rest of the app.
8	
9	## Stories
10	
11	- Story 3.1: Text Entry Capture & Insertion Modal Shell
12	- Story 3.2: Audio Entry Capture & On-Device Transcription
13	- Story 3.3: Photo Entry Capture & Backend OCR
14	- Story 3.4: Cancel-Safe Capture Across All Tabs
15	
16	## Requirements & Constraints
17	
18	- All three capture modalities (text, audio, photo) must produce the same persisted Entry shape; `source` is `manual`/`audio`/`photo` respectively, and each `POST /entries` call must carry the correct one.
19	- Audio and photo Entries are only "complete" once processed: audio via on-device transcription, photo via backend OCR. The transcribed/recognized text is editable before the user taps Salvar; the Entry is only created on explicit save, not automatically after processing finishes.
20	- Audio transcription runs 100% on-device via `whisper_ggml`; no call in this pipeline may ever contain audio bytes. The audio pipeline has exactly four states in sequence: recording → processing → transcribed → (on failure) error with retry; the recorded media is never discarded on a transcription failure.
21	- Photo OCR calls the backend before the Entry is created, mirroring the same four-state shape: capture → processing OCR → recognized → error. `OCR_NO_TEXT` is a distinct, non-retryable outcome with two recovery paths: "Tentar novamente" (retry OCR on the same photo) and "Salvar só a foto" (save with no extracted text) — never a single generic failure message. An oversized photo returns non-retryable `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` (413); show a size-specific message with no retry button.
22	- Cancel-safety (FR-11) is absolute: interrupting a capture before Salvar — closing the modal, switching Insertion Modal tabs, backing out mid-photo, stopping a recording early — must never fire `POST /entries`. Opening the modal always resets all three tabs to idle/empty; switching tabs mid-capture cancels the in-flight capture outright (resolved ambiguity — the prototype itself left this undefined).
23	- Offline: the "+" entry point is disabled with the same offline-banner treatment as chat send. Capture requires a live `POST /entries` round trip (PII check + embedding), so there is no local-only queued write — a write attempted with no connectivity resolves immediately to `NetworkOffline`, never queued.
24	- Every screen-reader-relevant state transition needs an announced label ("Gravando," "Transcrevendo," "Erro ao transcrever, toque para tentar novamente," etc.) — color/animation alone never carries state.
25	
26	## Technical Decisions
27	
28	- Two feature modules split the work: `features/entries/` owns the `Entry` entity, the `EntriesRepository` port (`create` + `read` only — no update/delete ever), and the entries `hive_ce` box. `features/capture/` owns the Insertion Modal UI, the on-device Whisper STT flow, and the OCR call, and holds no Entry data itself — it only consumes the abstract port from `entries/domain` (never imports `entries/data/` or `entries/presentation/`). This port is exactly what RF10 (Epic 6, save chat message as entry) and RF06/RF07 (Search, Timeline) will extend/reuse later — get its shape right here, not provisionally.
29	- `create` on the port is idempotent on `(origin, chatMessageId)`, though that specific guard only matters starting with RF10; this epic just needs to not violate the port's shape.
30	- Backend calls for this epic: `POST /entries` → function `entries-create`; `POST /media/ocr` → function `media-ocr` (the photo itself is not persisted server-side, only the extracted text comes back). Both calls follow the standard header rules (`apikey` always, `Authorization: Bearer <user token>`, since neither operation is one of the three `security: []` exceptions).
31	- Error handling: map the 13 backend error codes (plus the local-only `MalformedResponse`) to the one sealed `Failure` hierarchy already defined in `core/failure/`. For this epic specifically: `OcrNoText` and `PayloadTooLarge` are both non-retryable and need their own distinct UI treatment, not a generic error state. The retry interceptor fires only for the 6 server `retryable:true` codes — OCR/payload failures are never auto-retried.
32	- The capture feature defines its own sealed state class for its multi-step audio/OCR state machines — it is explicitly excluded from using the shared generic `Resource<T>` type (`Resource<T>` is reserved for RF06/RF09's simpler single-fetch screens).
33	- The Insertion Modal's three tabs are internal states of one bottom sheet, never nested sheets; its entrance animation is the shared `sheetUp` (0.2s) choreography, with no other motion invented.
34	
35	## UX & Interaction Patterns
36	
37	- Insertion Modal: three equal-width tabs (Texto/Áudio/Foto); only the active tab gets a filled `colorPrimary` background. A close ("x") control is always present. The modal opens on Texto by default.
38	- Audio tab: an animated multi-bar waveform with a monospace running timer while recording; on stop, the waveform freezes at 35% opacity with a "Transcrevendo..." label while processing (no spinner needed beyond that). Once transcribed, text is editable and "Salvar" enables; the original audio duration shows in monospace.
39	- Photo tab: thumbnail + spinner + "Reconhecendo texto..." while OCR runs. Once recognized, text is editable before Salvar.
40	- Dynamic Type and tap-target rules (≥44pt, no truncation at largest accessibility text size) apply to all controls built here, same as everywhere else in the app.
41	- Reduce Motion: this epic has no cursor-blink (that's Chat), but still must honor the `sheetUp`/`scrimIn`-only animation rule and skip it when Reduce Motion is on.
42	
43	## Cross-Story Dependencies
44	
45	- Story 3.1 is the first consumer of `features/entries/` and must stand up the `Entry` entity, `EntriesRepository` port (`create`), and the entries Hive box — Stories 3.2 and 3.3 build on top of this rather than creating their own local Entry model.
46	- Story 3.4 (cancel-safety) is a cross-cutting rule that applies to the tab/state machines built in 3.1–3.3; it's written as its own story but has no independent UI surface — it hardens behavior already present in the other three.
47	- This epic depends on Epic 2 (Biometric Vault): the Insertion Modal is only reachable once the vault is unlocked.
48	- Everything this epic builds in `features/entries/` is a hard dependency for Epic 4 (Timeline), Epic 5 (Search), and Epic 6's RF10 (save-to-journal) — those epics extend this port rather than replacing it.

# Epic 3 Context: Multimodal Capture & Processing

<!-- Compiled from planning artifacts. Edit freely. Regenerate with compile-epic-context if planning docs change. -->

## Goal

Users capture a journal Entry through one shared Insertion Modal in three ways — typed text, recorded audio, or a photo — and every modality ends up as the same persisted `Entry` shape. Audio is transcribed entirely on-device; a photo's text is recognized server-side via OCR before the Entry exists. Text and audio/photo stay merged into one epic because an un-transcribed audio Entry or un-OCR'd photo Entry is not a usable product outcome on its own — "capture" and "process" are one milestone here, not two. The epic also guarantees interrupting any capture (switching tabs, backing out, stopping early) never leaves a stray partial or empty Entry behind. This is the first epic to introduce `features/entries/`, which every later epic that creates or reads an Entry (Timeline, Search, Chat save-to-journal) will consume through its port — so decisions made here about that port's shape are load-bearing for the rest of the app.

## Stories

- Story 3.1: Text Entry Capture & Insertion Modal Shell
- Story 3.2: Audio Entry Capture & On-Device Transcription
- Story 3.3: Photo Entry Capture & Backend OCR
- Story 3.4: Cancel-Safe Capture Across All Tabs

## Requirements & Constraints

- All three capture modalities (text, audio, photo) must produce the same persisted Entry shape; `source` is `manual`/`audio`/`photo` respectively, and each `POST /entries` call must carry the correct one.

- Audio transcription runs 100% on-device via `whisper_ggml`; no call in this pipeline may ever contain audio bytes. The audio pipeline has exactly four states in sequence: recording → processing → transcribed → (on failure) error with retry; the recorded media is never discarded on a transcription failure.
- Photo OCR calls the backend before the Entry is created, mirroring the same four-state shape: capture → processing OCR → recognized → error. `OCR_NO_TEXT` is a distinct, non-retryable outcome with two recovery paths: "Tentar novamente" (retry OCR on the same photo) and "Salvar só a foto" (save with no extracted text) — never a single generic failure message. An oversized photo returns non-retryable `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` (413); show a size-specific message with no retry button.
- Cancel-safety (FR-11) is absolute: interrupting a capture before Salvar — closing the modal, switching Insertion Modal tabs, backing out mid-photo, stopping a recording early — must never fire `POST /entries`. Opening the modal always resets all three tabs to idle/empty; switching tabs mid-capture cancels the in-flight capture outright (resolved ambiguity — the prototype itself left this undefined).
- Offline: the "+" entry point is disabled with the same offline-banner treatment as chat send. Capture requires a live `POST /entries` round trip (PII check + embedding), so there is no local-only queued write — a write attempted with no connectivity resolves immediately to `NetworkOffline`, never queued.
- Every screen-reader-relevant state transition needs an announced label ("Gravando," "Transcrevendo," "Erro ao transcrever, toque para tentar novamente," etc.) — color/animation alone never carries state.

## Technical Decisions

- Two feature modules split the work: `features/entries/` owns the `Entry` entity, the `EntriesRepository` port (`create` + `read` only — no update/delete ever), and the entries `hive_ce` box. `features/capture/` owns the Insertion Modal UI, the on-device Whisper STT flow, and the OCR call, and holds no Entry data itself — it only consumes the abstract port from `entries/domain` (never imports `entries/data/` or `entries/presentation/`). This port is exactly what RF10 (Epic 6, save chat message as entry) and RF06/RF07 (Search, Timeline) will extend/reuse later — get its shape right here, not provisionally.
- `create` on the port is idempotent on `(origin, chatMessageId)`, though that specific guard only matters starting with RF10; this epic just needs to not violate the port's shape.
- Backend calls for this epic: `POST /entries` → function `entries-create`; `POST /media/ocr` → function `media-ocr` (the photo itself is not persisted server-side, only the extracted text comes back). Both calls follow the standard header rules (`apikey` always, `Authorization: Bearer <user token>`, since neither operation is one of the three `security: []` exceptions).
- Error handling: map the 13 backend error codes (plus the local-only `MalformedResponse`) to the one sealed `Failure` hierarchy already defined in `core/failure/`. For this epic specifically: `OcrNoText` and `PayloadTooLarge` are both non-retryable and need their own distinct UI treatment, not a generic error state. The retry interceptor fires only for the 6 server `retryable:true` codes — OCR/payload failures are never auto-retried.
- The capture feature defines its own sealed state class for its multi-step audio/OCR state machines — it is explicitly excluded from using the shared generic `Resource<T>` type (`Resource<T>` is reserved for RF06/RF09's simpler single-fetch screens).
- The Insertion Modal's three tabs are internal states of one bottom sheet, never nested sheets; its entrance animation is the shared `sheetUp` (0.2s) choreography, with no other motion invented.

## UX & Interaction Patterns

- Insertion Modal: three equal-width tabs (Texto/Áudio/Foto); only the active tab gets a filled `colorPrimary` background. A close ("x") control is always present. The modal opens on Texto by default.
- Audio tab: an animated multi-bar waveform with a monospace running timer while recording; on stop, the waveform freezes at 35% opacity with a "Transcrevendo..." label while processing (no spinner needed beyond that). Once transcribed, text is editable and "Salvar" enables; the original audio duration shows in monospace.
- Photo tab: thumbnail + spinner + "Reconhecendo texto..." while OCR runs. Once recognized, text is editable before Salvar.
- Dynamic Type and tap-target rules (≥44pt, no truncation at largest accessibility text size) apply to all controls built here, same as everywhere else in the app.
- Reduce Motion: this epic has no cursor-blink (that's Chat), but still must honor the `sheetUp`/`scrimIn`-only animation rule and skip it when Reduce Motion is on.

## Cross-Story Dependencies

- Story 3.1 is the first consumer of `features/entries/` and must stand up the `Entry` entity, `EntriesRepository` port (`create`), and the entries Hive box — Stories 3.2 and 3.3 build on top of this rather than creating their own local Entry model.

13	## Intent
14	
15	**Problem:** The Áudio tab is still an idle placeholder (`_IdleTabPlaceholder`) — recording, on-device transcription, and saving a `source=audio` Entry don't exist, and the app has no audio-recording package or microphone-permission handling at all.
16	
17	**Approach:** Add a new `AudioEntryCubit` (its own sealed state, separate from `TextEntryCubit`) driving the 4-state pipeline — recording → processing → transcribed → error — backed by two new `capture/domain` ports: `MicRecorder` (`record` package) and `AudioTranscriber` (`whisper_ggml`). Extend `Entry`/`EntriesRepository.create` with the optional `mediaDurationSeconds` field the backend contract already reserves. Wire tab switching into/out of Áudio to start/stop the recorder.

Recording starts/stops from `InsertionModal`'s existing tab-switch listener. **Execution:**

- [x] `lib/features/capture/domain/services/mic_recorder.dart` (new) -- abstract `MicRecorder` port.
- [x] `lib/features/capture/domain/services/audio_transcriber.dart` (new) -- abstract `AudioTranscriber` port.
- [x] `lib/features/capture/data/services/record_mic_recorder.dart` (new) -- `record`-backed implementation.
- [x] `lib/features/capture/data/services/whisper_audio_transcriber.dart` (new) -- `whisper_ggml`-backed implementation.
- [x] `lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/audio_entry_cubit.dart` (new) -- `AudioEntryCubit` + `AudioCaptureState` hierarchy.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given the Áudio tab, when I switch into it, then recording starts immediately with an animated waveform and monospace running timer.
- Given recording stops, when `whisper_ggml` transcribes on-device, then the waveform freezes at 35% opacity during processing and no network call in this pipeline ever carries audio bytes.
- Given transcription completes, when I review the text, then it is editable before Salvar, and the resulting Entry carries `source: audio` and `mediaDurationSeconds`.
- Given `fvm flutter analyze` and `fvm flutter test`, then both report zero issues / all green.

### Review Findings

**Patch:**
- [x] [Review][Patch] `AudioEntryCubit.cancel()` never deletes the temp recording file for `AudioTranscribed`/a file-carrying `AudioError` — dismissing the whole modal (not a tab switch) while reviewing transcribed text or after a failed save permanently orphans that `.wav` file, since `close()` runs right after and nothing will ever clean it up. `cancel()` only has cleanup branches for `AudioRecording`/`AudioProcessing`. Decision: patch now (extend `cancel()`'s cleanup to these two states). Fixed via a new `cancel({bool discardPreserved = false})` param; `InsertionModal.show()`'s `finally` now passes `discardPreserved: true`. [lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/audio_entry_cubit.dart:330]
- [x] [Review][Patch] No test exercises full-modal dismiss (e.g. "x" tap) while `AudioRecording`/`AudioProcessing`, so the existing `audioCubit.cancel()` call in `InsertionModal.show()`'s `finally` has no regression coverage [lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart:94]
- [x] [Review][Patch] No test asserts "Salvando registro" is announced while an audio save is in flight (the Texto tab's equivalent has one) [lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart:263]
- [x] [Review][Patch] `_deleteRecordingFile` cleanup after a successful save or an abandoned mid-processing recording is never verified against a real file — every cubit/widget test uses fake paths that silently no-op the delete [lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/audio_entry_cubit.dart:437]
- [x] [Review][Patch] `stopRecording()` reads `_generation` but never bumps it on entry (unlike `startRecording()`) — a rapid double-tap on the stop control before the UI rebuilds can let a second, stale `_micRecorder.stop()` call overwrite a valid `AudioProcessing`/transcription result with a bogus `AudioError`. Fixed with a `_stopping` re-entry guard rather than a generation bump (bumping alone would have let the wrong call's result win). [lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/audio_entry_cubit.dart:208]
- [x] [Review][Patch] `MicRecorder` native calls (`hasPermission`/`start`/`stop`/`cancel`) are never wrapped in try/catch — a thrown `PlatformException` escapes uncaught; inside `InsertionModal.show()`'s `finally`, that would also skip the following `audioCubit.close()` [lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/audio_entry_cubit.dart:161]
- [x] [Review][Patch] `_Waveform`'s `amplitudeStream.listen()` has no `onError` handler — an error from the native amplitude stream becomes an uncaught async exception [lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart:945]
- [x] [Review][Patch] `RecordMicRecorder.stop()` computes `durationSeconds` via `DateTime.now().difference(startedAt).inSeconds` with no floor — a backward clock adjustment mid-recording yields a negative value, which the backend's `mediaDurationSeconds: minimum 0` contract will reject, turning an otherwise-successful recording into a save failure. Fixed by flooring at 0 (no dedicated regression test — exercising a real backward clock jump isn't practically simulable without a clock-injection refactor out of scope for this patch). [lib/features/capture/data/services/record_mic_recorder.dart:73]
- [x] [Review][Patch] `AudioIdle` is the one `AudioCaptureState` transition never announced to screen readers (`case AudioIdle(): break;`) — masked today only because its one reachable path (tab-switch away while recording) coincides with the separate tab-switch announcement [lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart:278]
- [x] [Review][Patch] No test covers `cancel()` racing a `retry()`-triggered re-transcription — appears already safe via `_transcribe`'s own state-based guard, but unverified by any test [lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/audio_entry_cubit.dart:282]

**Defer:**
- [x] [Review][Defer] No maximum recording duration is enforced anywhere — the elapsed-timer `MM:SS` label has no cap past 99 minutes and nothing bounds an unboundedly long on-device transcription; not called for anywhere in the spec's I/O matrix, a product/UX decision rather than a technical one [lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart:694] — deferred, out of this story's scope
- [x] [Review][Defer] `WhisperAudioTranscriber.transcribe()` calls `downloadModel()` on every invocation, including every "Tentar novamente" retry, with no cached-already-downloaded short-circuit in this wrapper — likely benign (the underlying package most likely no-ops once cached) but unverified third-party behavior [lib/features/capture/data/services/whisper_audio_transcriber.dart:14] — deferred, low-confidence/unverified

## Spec Change Log

## Design Notes

- **Two cubits, one modal:** `TextEntryCubit` stays the modal's `activeTab` source of truth; `AudioEntryCubit` only owns the audio pipeline — avoids rearchitecting `TextEntryCubit` or merging unrelated state shapes.
- **`WhisperModel.base`, `lang: 'pt'`, lazy download inside `transcribe()`:** balances accuracy/size; a missing model + no connectivity just surfaces through the same generic error/retry path as any other transcription failure — no new state needed.
- **`mediaDurationSeconds` lands now, not "later":** `entry.dart`'s own Story 3.1 comment named it as deferred to "later epics" — this is that story.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter pub get` -- resolves `record` with no conflicts.
- `fvm flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` -- regenerates `entry_dto.g.dart` with the new field.
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` -- all green.

**Manual checks (if no CLI):**
- On a real device/simulator (none exists yet, AGENTS.md): record a short Portuguese phrase, confirm it transcribes and an `audio`-sourced Entry saves; optionally compare against `docs/input/backend/fixtures/media/audio_fixture_01.wav` + `expected-transcription.md` for rough transcription-quality sanity, not exact match.

## Suggested Review Order

**Audio capture state machine**

- The pipeline's own sealed states and the 3 failure-row shapes (`AudioError`'s permission/transcription/save variants) — the main architectural bet of this story.
  [`audio_entry_cubit.dart:16`](../../lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/audio_entry_cubit.dart#L16)

- `_generation` — review-added guard so `cancel()` running mid-await (tab switch during `startRecording()`/`stopRecording()`) can't leave the recorder running or resurrect a dropped flow.
  [`audio_entry_cubit.dart:134`](../../lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/audio_entry_cubit.dart#L134)

- `startRecording()` — only (re)starts from `AudioIdle` or a permission-denied `AudioError`; review-added guard against silently discarding `AudioTranscribed`/`AudioError` work on re-entry.
  [`audio_entry_cubit.dart:152`](../../lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/audio_entry_cubit.dart#L152)

- `stopRecording()` — the post-`stop()` generation check that stops a stale result from resurrecting a canceled flow.
  [`audio_entry_cubit.dart:204`](../../lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/audio_entry_cubit.dart#L204)

- `save()` — review-added: now also retries from a save-failure `AudioError`, not only `AudioTranscribed`; deletes the temp file on success.
  [`audio_entry_cubit.dart:372`](../../lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/audio_entry_cubit.dart#L372)

- `cancel()` — the I/O matrix's "Leave tab mid-recording" row; review-added file cleanup for the abandoned mid-processing case.
  [`audio_entry_cubit.dart:330`](../../lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/audio_entry_cubit.dart#L330)

**MicRecorder / AudioTranscriber ports**

- The abstract port `AudioEntryCubit` depends on instead of `package:record` directly — decouples the cubit from the native plugin.
  [`mic_recorder.dart:20`](../../lib/features/capture/domain/services/mic_recorder.dart#L20)

- `RecordMicRecorder` — wraps `package:record`'s `AudioRecorder`; review-added: `cancel()` now deletes the file itself rather than solely trusting the plugin's own contract.
  [`record_mic_recorder.dart:67`](../../lib/features/capture/data/services/record_mic_recorder.dart#L67)

- `WhisperAudioTranscriber` — wraps `whisper_ggml`'s `WhisperController`, lazy `downloadModel` + `transcribe(lang: 'pt')`, `null` on any failure.
  [`whisper_audio_transcriber.dart:14`](../../lib/features/capture/data/services/whisper_audio_transcriber.dart#L14)

**Insertion Modal wiring**

- `show()` — review-added: `audioCubit.cancel()` before `close()`, so dismissing the whole modal (not just switching tabs) actually releases the mic.
  [`insertion_modal.dart:35`](../../lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart#L35)

- `build()` — review-added: `isSaving` now also reads `AudioEntryCubit`'s own saving flag, closing the race that let the tab bar/close button stay tappable mid-audio-save.
  [`insertion_modal.dart:284`](../../lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart#L284)

3:Cerne is a reflective-journaling mobile app with an AI assistant. The user records their day by text, audio or photo; a conversational agent consults those records (semantic search) to answer with context and to offer insights.
11:### RF01 — Multimodal capture (text / audio / photo)
12:Data entry by text, real-time audio recording and photo upload — always through Screen 2 (Insertion Modal), which has a raw text field in addition to the microphone and the gallery. Every capture becomes a persisted record (`POST /entries`), **distinct from a chat message** (see the separation note in RF04).
15:- The three modalities (text, audio, photo) result in the same persisted-entry format — none is treated structurally differently from the others after capture.
18:### RF02 — Speech-to-text / OCR processing
19:Transcription of audio (speech-to-text) and recognition of text in images (OCR) over the content captured in RF01.
131:**Screen 2 — Insertion Modal:** overlay with three ways to capture — raw text field, microphone (audio) and gallery/camera (photo) — with a transcription indicator. Every capture here creates a persisted entry, never a chat message. *Connects to: RF01, RF02.*

147:Every endpoint returns errors in the standard contract of RNF09 — `{ code, message, retryable }` — and is protected by RLS in Supabase. AI providers: Claude (chat, vision/OCR, summary, insights, dashboard, PII detection) and Voyage AI (embeddings) — the backend's only two external AI dependencies. Audio transcription (speech-to-text) runs on-device (Whisper) and never reaches the backend as an audio file.

6	|---|---|---|
7	| `AUTH_EXPIRED` | 401 | no |
8	| `AUTH_INVALID` | 401 | no |
9	| `NETWORK_TIMEOUT` | 504 | yes |
10	| `NETWORK_OFFLINE` | _(no HTTP response — see note)_ | yes |
11	| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | no |
12	| `PII_CHECK_FAILED` | 502 | yes |
13	| `EMBEDDING_FAILED` | 502 | yes |
14	| `AI_GENERATION_TIMEOUT` | 504 | yes |
15	| `NOT_FOUND` | 404 | no |
16	| `RATE_LIMITED` | 429 | yes |
17	| `EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` | 400 | no |
18	| `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` | 413 | no |
19	| `OCR_NO_TEXT` | 400 | no |
20	
21	**Two deliberate design choices (these never happen in this API):**
22	- **Never `403`** — a resource belonging to another user always answers `404 NOT_FOUND` (so its existence is not revealed).
23	- **Never `409`** — the idempotency of RF10 (re-sending the same chat message as an entry) always answers `200`; there is no "conflict" code.
24

# Error taxonomy — 13 codes

Every endpoint returns errors as `{ code, message, retryable }`. The list below is closed: no other code exists.

| Code | HTTP | Retryable |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_EXPIRED` | 401 | no |
| `AUTH_INVALID` | 401 | no |
| `NETWORK_TIMEOUT` | 504 | yes |
| `NETWORK_OFFLINE` | _(no HTTP response — see note)_ | yes |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | no |
| `PII_CHECK_FAILED` | 502 | yes |
| `EMBEDDING_FAILED` | 502 | yes |
| `AI_GENERATION_TIMEOUT` | 504 | yes |
| `NOT_FOUND` | 404 | no |
| `RATE_LIMITED` | 429 | yes |
| `EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` | 400 | no |
| `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` | 413 | no |
| `OCR_NO_TEXT` | 400 | no |

**Two deliberate design choices (these never happen in this API):**
- **Never `403`** — a resource belonging to another user always answers `404 NOT_FOUND` (so its existence is not revealed).
- **Never `409`** — the idempotency of RF10 (re-sending the same chat message as an entry) always answers `200`; there is no "conflict" code.

**`NETWORK_OFFLINE` has no HTTP status:** it is the only code that never becomes an actual response — it represents a connection that ends without any response.

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** The Foto tab is still an idle placeholder (`CaptureTab.foto => _IdleTabPlaceholder`, `insertion_modal.dart:356-359`) — picking a photo, server-side OCR via `POST /media/ocr`, and saving a `source=photo` Entry don't exist, and the app has no image-picker package at all.

**Approach:** Add a new `PhotoEntryCubit` (own sealed state, separate from `TextEntryCubit`/`AudioEntryCubit`) driving capture → processingOcr → recognized → error, backed by a new `capture/domain` port `PhotoPicker` (`image_picker`) and a new `capture/data` `MediaRepository`/`MediaRemoteDataSource` calling `media-ocr`. Wire Foto tab switching into the picker; `OcrNoText`/`PayloadTooLarge` each get their own distinct, non-retryable error UI.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- `image_picker: ^1.1.2` (new dependency) powers the "Câmera"/"Galeria" buttons. New `capture/domain` port `PhotoPicker` (`pickFromCamera()`/`pickFromGallery()` → `PickedPhoto? {path, mimeType}`, `null` = user canceled) wraps it — mirrors `MicRecorder`'s port convention (`mic_recorder.dart:20-46`); never call `ImagePicker` directly from the cubit. `mimeType` is inferred from the picked file's extension (jpeg/png/webp only, matching the contract's enum).
- OCR belongs to `capture/`, never `entries/` (epic Technical Decisions: "`features/capture/` ... holds no Entry data itself"). New `capture/domain/repositories/media_repository.dart` (`recognizeText({required Uint8List imageBytes, required String mimeType}) -> Either<Failure, OcrResult>` where `OcrResult{text, confidence}`), `capture/data/datasources/media_remote_data_source.dart` + `capture/data/repositories/media_repository_impl.dart` mirroring `entries_remote_data_source.dart:21-46`/`entries_repository_impl.dart:29-51` but with **no Hive persistence step** — the image is never persisted, forward the datasource's `Either` as-is. Calls `ApiClient.post('media-ocr', data: {image: base64Encode(bytes), mimeType: mimeType})` (`api_client.dart:52-62`); base64-encodes only inside the datasource.
- `PhotoEntryCubit(this._photoPicker, this._mediaRepository, this._entriesRepository)`, own sealed `PhotoCaptureState`: `PhotoIdle` → `PhotoProcessing(path, mimeType)` → `PhotoRecognized(path, mimeType, text, saving)` / `PhotoSaved` / `PhotoError(path, mimeType, message, kind, text?)`. `kind` is a 3-way discriminator (`generic | ocrNoText | payloadTooLarge`) driving three distinct branches — `Failure.ocrNoText`/`Failure.payloadTooLarge` already exist (`failure.dart:32-34,80-81`): **ocrNoText** → "Tentar novamente" (re-OCR same image via `retry()`) + "Salvar só a foto" (`saveWithoutText()`, creates the Entry with a fixed non-empty placeholder `content` — e.g. `"Registro fotográfico (sem texto reconhecido)"` — since the contract's `content.minLength: 1` forbids empty); **payloadTooLarge** → size-specific message, no action besides picking a different photo (no retry, no "Salvar só a foto"); **generic** (any other `Failure`, incl. a save failure, `text` non-null) → plain "Tentar novamente" re-running whichever call failed, same shape as `AudioError`.
- Recognized/placeholder text saves via `_entriesRepository.create(source: EntrySource.photo, content: <text>)` — `EntrySource.photo` already exists (`entry.dart:6`), no `Entry`/DTO change needed.
- Every transition gets a screen-reader announcement via the existing `_announce` helper (`insertion_modal.dart:196-205`). `InsertionModal.show`/`build` gain a third `photoCubit` param, provided via the existing `MultiBlocProvider` (`insertion_modal.dart:106-107`), canceled+closed in `show()`'s `finally` alongside the other two (mirrors `audioCubit.cancel(discardPreserved: true)` + `close()`, lines 97-98). `isSaving` (`insertion_modal.dart:310`) must also OR in `PhotoEntryCubit`'s own saving flag — the exact cross-tab race 3.2's review already fixed for Audio.
- `NSCameraUsageDescription`/`NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription` added to `ios/Runner/Info.plist` after the existing Face ID/mic keys (line 32), same style.
- Use the `_generation` counter pattern (`audio_entry_cubit.dart:134`) in `PhotoEntryCubit` for the same tab-switch-mid-await race, now across the picker call and the OCR network call.

**Ask First:** none identified.

**Never:**
- Persist the image anywhere beyond the in-flight OCR call (no local cache, no backend storage) — only extracted text ever moves on.
- Implement the full cross-tab cancel-safety rule (Story 3.4) — this story's trivial case only: `create` fires only on explicit Salvar/"Salvar só a foto"; leaving Foto mid-pick/mid-OCR just discards the in-flight picker call/OCR request.
- Add HEIC→JPEG conversion or any client-side image-size pre-check — anything outside jpeg/png/webp (e.g. iOS HEIC) is a known gap, deferred like 3.2's untested native-plugin edges (no device exists to verify).
- Write a test exercising the real `image_picker` native plugin — mock it (mocktail), same convention as `MicRecorder`/`AudioTranscriber`.
- Touch Story 3.1/3.2's Texto/Áudio tabs beyond the shared `InsertionModal` wiring already described above.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Happy path | Switch to Foto, tap Câmera or Galeria, pick a jpeg/png/webp photo | Thumbnail+spinner "Reconhecendo texto..." while OCR runs; recognized text editable; Salvar fires `POST /entries` (`source: photo`), success closes modal | N/A |
| `OCR_NO_TEXT` | `media-ocr` succeeds with no usable text | Thumbnail kept, "Não foi possível reconhecer o texto"; "Tentar novamente" re-OCRs same image, "Salvar só a foto" saves with placeholder content | Non-retryable, two distinct recovery paths |
| `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` | Picked image exceeds backend's limit | Size-specific message, no retry button, no "Salvar só a foto" | Non-retryable |
| User cancels picker | Câmera/Galeria dialog dismissed with no file chosen | Stays on Foto's capture buttons (`PhotoIdle`) | N/A |
| Save fails (incl. offline) | Salvar tapped from `PhotoRecognized`/a save-failure `PhotoError`, `create` returns a `Failure` | Inline message from `Failure.message`; Salvar re-enabled, text/photo preserved | `Failure.fromCode`, no auto-retry |
| Leave tab mid-pick/OCR | Switch to Texto/Áudio while `PhotoProcessing` | In-flight picker call/OCR request discarded; no `POST /entries` fires | N/A |

- [ ] `lib/features/capture/domain/repositories/media_repository.dart` (new) -- abstract `MediaRepository` port.
- [ ] `lib/features/capture/data/datasources/media_remote_data_source.dart` (new) -- `media-ocr` call.
- [ ] `lib/features/capture/data/repositories/media_repository_impl.dart` (new) -- forwards datasource result.
- [ ] `lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/photo_entry_cubit.dart` (new) -- `PhotoEntryCubit` + `PhotoCaptureState` hierarchy.
- [ ] `lib/features/capture/capture_injection.dart` -- register new picker/media/cubit bindings.
- [ ] `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart` -- third cubit wiring, tab-switch discard, `isSaving` OR, new `_FotoTab` widget.
- [ ] `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart` -- resolve and pass `PhotoEntryCubit`.
- [ ] `ios/Runner/Info.plist` -- add camera/photo-library usage descriptions.
- [ ] Unit/widget tests under `test/features/capture/` covering the I/O matrix above.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given the Foto tab, when I tap Câmera or Galeria and pick a photo, then a thumbnail and "Reconhecendo texto..." show while `POST /media/ocr` runs, with no image bytes ever reaching `POST /entries`.
- Given `OCR_NO_TEXT`, when the error shows, then both "Tentar novamente" and "Salvar só a foto" are present and each behaves per the I/O matrix.
- Given `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE`, when the error shows, then no retry or save-without-text action is offered.
- Given recognized text, when I edit it and tap Salvar, then the resulting Entry carries `source: photo` and the edited text.
- Given `fvm flutter analyze` and `fvm flutter test`, then both report zero issues / all green.

## Design Notes

- **Three-way `PhotoError.kind` instead of `AudioError`'s binary `canRetry`:** Audio only ever has one non-retryable shape (a save failure); Photo has two distinct non-retryable backend codes (`ocrNoText`, `payloadTooLarge`) needing different UI, plus the generic retryable case — a discriminator is clearer than overloading nullability tricks.
- **No separate "recording" phase:** unlike Audio's timed `recording` state, picking a photo is one blocking OS call — `PhotoIdle` goes straight to `PhotoProcessing` once the picker returns a file, no intermediate state needed.
- **`confidence` is a string enum (`high`/`low`), not numeric** — carried on `OcrResult` but not surfaced in any UI per this story's scope (not called for in the brief); available for a future story if needed.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter pub get` -- resolves `image_picker` with no conflicts.
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` -- all green.

**Manual checks (if no CLI):**
- On a real device/simulator (none exists yet, AGENTS.md): pick a photo with visible text, confirm OCR recognizes it and a `photo`-sourced Entry saves; confirm an oversized image triggers the `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` UI and a text-free image triggers `OCR_NO_TEXT`'s two recovery paths.

content.content:
1	---
2	title: 'Story 3.3: Photo Entry Capture & Backend OCR'
3	type: 'feature'
4	created: '2026-11-04'
5	status: 'draft'
6	review_loop_iteration: 0
7	context: []
8	---
9	
10	<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">
11	
12	## Intent
13	
14	**Problem:** The Foto tab is still an idle placeholder (`CaptureTab.foto => _IdleTabPlaceholder`, `insertion_modal.dart:356-359`) — picking a photo, server-side OCR via `POST /media/ocr`, and saving a `source=photo` Entry don't exist, and the app has no image-picker package at all.
15	
16	**Approach:** Add a new `PhotoEntryCubit` (own sealed state, separate from `TextEntryCubit`/`AudioEntryCubit`) driving capture → processingOcr → recognized → error, backed by a new `capture/domain` port `PhotoPicker` (`image_picker`) and a new `capture/data` `MediaRepository`/`MediaRemoteDataSource` calling `media-ocr`. Wire Foto tab switching into the picker; `OcrNoText`/`PayloadTooLarge` each get their own distinct, non-retryable error UI.
17	
18	## Boundaries & Constraints
19	
20	**Always:**
21	- `image_picker: ^1.1.2` (new dependency) powers the "Câmera"/"Galeria" buttons. New `capture/domain` port `PhotoPicker` (`pickFromCamera()`/`pickFromGallery()` → `PickedPhoto? {path, mimeType}`, `null` = user canceled) wraps it — mirrors `MicRecorder`'s port convention (`mic_recorder.dart:20-46`); never call `ImagePicker` directly from the cubit. `mimeType` is inferred from the picked file's extension (jpeg/png/webp only, matching the contract's enum).
22	- OCR belongs to `capture/`, never `entries/` (epic Technical Decisions: "`features/capture/` ... holds no Entry data itself"). New `capture/domain/repositories/media_repository.dart` (`recognizeText({required Uint8List imageBytes, required String mimeType}) -> Either<Failure, OcrResult>` where `OcrResult{text, confidence}`), `capture/data/datasources/media_remote_data_source.dart` + `capture/data/repositories/media_repository_impl.dart` mirroring `entries_remote_data_source.dart:21-46`/`entries_repository_impl.dart:29-51` but with **no Hive persistence step** — the image is never persisted, forward the datasource's `Either` as-is. Calls `ApiClient.post('media-ocr', data: {image: base64Encode(bytes), mimeType: mimeType})` (`api_client.dart:52-62`); base64-encodes only inside the datasource.
23	- `PhotoEntryCubit(this._photoPicker, this._mediaRepository, this._entriesRepository)`, own sealed `PhotoCaptureState`: `PhotoIdle` → `PhotoProcessing(path, mimeType)` → `PhotoRecognized(path, mimeType, text, saving)` / `PhotoSaved` / `PhotoError(path, mimeType, message, kind, text?)`. `kind` is a 3-way discriminator (`generic | ocrNoText | payloadTooLarge`) driving three distinct branches — `Failure.ocrNoText`/`Failure.payloadTooLarge` already exist (`failure.dart:32-34,80-81`): **ocrNoText** → "Tentar novamente" (re-OCR same image via `retry()`) + "Salvar só a foto" (`saveWithoutText()`, creates the Entry with a fixed non-empty placeholder `content` — e.g. `"Registro fotográfico (sem texto reconhecido)"` — since the contract's `content.minLength: 1` forbids empty); **payloadTooLarge** → size-specific message, no action besides picking a different photo (no retry, no "Salvar só a foto"); **generic** (any other `Failure`, incl. a save failure, `text` non-null) → plain "Tentar novamente" re-running whichever call failed, same shape as `AudioError`.
24	- Recognized/placeholder text saves via `_entriesRepository.create(source: EntrySource.photo, content: <text>)` — `EntrySource.photo` already exists (`entry.dart:6`), no `Entry`/DTO change needed.
25	- Every transition gets a screen-reader announcement via the existing `_announce` helper (`insertion_modal.dart:196-205`). `InsertionModal.show`/`build` gain a third `photoCubit` param, provided via the existing `MultiBlocProvider` (`insertion_modal.dart:106-107`), canceled+closed in `show()`'s `finally` alongside the other two (mirrors `audioCubit.cancel(discardPreserved: true)` + `close()`, lines 97-98). `isSaving` (`insertion_modal.dart:310`) must also OR in `PhotoEntryCubit`'s own saving flag — the exact cross-tab race 3.2's review already fixed for Audio.
26	- `NSCameraUsageDescription`/`NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription` added to `ios/Runner/Info.plist` after the existing Face ID/mic keys (line 32), same style.
27	- Use the `_generation` counter pattern (`audio_entry_cubit.dart:134`) in `PhotoEntryCubit` for the same tab-switch-mid-await race, now across the picker call and the OCR network call.
28	
29	**Ask First:** none identified.
30	
31	**Never:**
32	- Persist the image anywhere beyond the in-flight OCR call (no local cache, no backend storage) — only extracted text ever moves on.
33	- Implement the full cross-tab cancel-safety rule (Story 3.4) — this story's trivial case only: `create` fires only on explicit Salvar/"Salvar só a foto"; leaving Foto mid-pick/mid-OCR just discards the in-flight picker call/OCR request.
34	- Add HEIC→JPEG conversion or any client-side image-size pre-check — anything outside jpeg/png/webp (e.g. iOS HEIC) is a known gap, deferred like 3.2's untested native-plugin edges (no device exists to verify).
35	- Write a test exercising the real `image_picker` native plugin — mock it (mocktail), same convention as `MicRecorder`/`AudioTranscriber`.
36	- Touch Story 3.1/3.2's Texto/Áudio tabs beyond the shared `InsertionModal` wiring already described above.
37	
38	## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix
39	
40	| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
41	|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
42	| Happy path | Switch to Foto, tap Câmera or Galeria, pick a jpeg/png/webp photo | Thumbnail+spinner "Reconhecendo texto..." while OCR runs; recognized text editable; Salvar fires `POST /entries` (`source: photo`), success closes modal | N/A |
43	| `OCR_NO_TEXT` | `media-ocr` succeeds with no usable text | Thumbnail kept, "Não foi possível reconhecer o texto"; "Tentar novamente" re-OCRs same image, "Salvar só a foto" saves with placeholder content | Non-retryable, two distinct recovery paths |
44	| `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` | Picked image exceeds backend's limit | Size-specific message, no retry button, no "Salvar só a foto" | Non-retryable |
45	| User cancels picker | Câmera/Galeria dialog dismissed with no file chosen | Stays on Foto's capture buttons (`PhotoIdle`) | N/A |
46	| Save fails (incl. offline) | Salvar tapped from `PhotoRecognized`/a save-failure `PhotoError`, `create` returns a `Failure` | Inline message from `Failure.message`; Salvar re-enabled, text/photo preserved | `Failure.fromCode`, no auto-retry |
47	| Leave tab mid-pick/OCR | Switch to Texto/Áudio while `PhotoProcessing` | In-flight picker call/OCR request discarded; no `POST /entries` fires | N/A |
48	
49	</frozen-after-approval>
50	
51	## Code Map
52	
53	- `pubspec.yaml:53` (after `record`) -- add `image_picker: ^1.1.2`.
54	- `lib/features/capture/domain/services/photo_picker.dart` (new) -- abstract `PhotoPicker { pickFromCamera()/pickFromGallery() -> Future<PickedPhoto?>; }`, `PickedPhoto{path, mimeType}` -- mirrors `mic_recorder.dart`.
55	- `lib/features/capture/data/services/image_picker_photo_picker.dart` (new) -- wraps `package:image_picker`'s `ImagePicker`, infers `mimeType` from extension.
56	- `lib/features/capture/domain/repositories/media_repository.dart` (new) -- abstract `MediaRepository { recognizeText(...) -> Future<Either<Failure, OcrResult>>; }`, `OcrResult{text, confidence}`.
57	- `lib/features/capture/data/datasources/media_remote_data_source.dart` (new) -- calls `ApiClient.post('media-ocr', ...)`, base64-encodes bytes, parses `data` -- mirrors `entries_remote_data_source.dart:21-46`.
58	- `lib/features/capture/data/repositories/media_repository_impl.dart` (new) -- forwards datasource `Either`, no Hive step -- mirrors `entries_repository_impl.dart:29-51` minus persistence.
59	- `lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/photo_entry_cubit.dart` (new) -- `PhotoEntryCubit` + `PhotoCaptureState` hierarchy, mirrors `audio_entry_cubit.dart`'s shape (states 17-108, methods 160-543, `_generation` guard at 134).
60	- `lib/features/capture/capture_injection.dart:48` (before closing `}`) -- register `ImagePicker`, `PhotoPicker`, `MediaRemoteDataSource`, `MediaRepository`, `PhotoEntryCubit` (factory, like `AudioEntryCubit`).
61	- `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart:35-100` (`show`) -- accept third `photoCubit`, cancel+close it in `finally`.
62	- `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart:102-111` (`build`) -- add third `BlocProvider.value(value: photoCubit)`.
63	- `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart:207-249` (tab-switch listener) -- extend to discard in-flight photo pick/OCR on leaving Foto.
64	- `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart:305-310` (`isSaving`) -- OR in `PhotoEntryCubit`'s saving flag.
65	- `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart:356-359` -- replace `_IdleTabPlaceholder` with new `_FotoTab` widget (mirrors `_AudioTab:634-670`; capture-buttons sub-state instead of a recording view, two-button error sub-state for `ocrNoText`).
66	- `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart:96-100` -- resolve `sl<PhotoEntryCubit>()`, pass to `InsertionModal.show`.
67	- `ios/Runner/Info.plist:32` -- add `NSCameraUsageDescription`/`NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription`.
68	- `test/features/capture/**` -- mirror 3.2's layout (`data/services/image_picker_photo_picker_test.dart`, `data/datasources/media_remote_data_source_test.dart`, `data/repositories/media_repository_impl_test.dart`, `presentation/cubit/photo_entry_cubit_test.dart`, `presentation/widgets/insertion_modal_photo_test.dart`).
69	
70	## Tasks & Acceptance
71	
72	**Execution:**
73	- [ ] `pubspec.yaml` -- add `image_picker: ^1.1.2`.
74	- [ ] `lib/features/capture/domain/services/photo_picker.dart` (new) -- abstract `PhotoPicker` port.
75	- [ ] `lib/features/capture/data/services/image_picker_photo_picker.dart` (new) -- `image_picker`-backed implementation.
76	- [ ] `lib/features/capture/domain/repositories/media_repository.dart` (new) -- abstract `MediaRepository` port.

type: 'feature'

## Intent

**Problem:** The Foto tab is still an idle placeholder (`CaptureTab.foto => _IdleTabPlaceholder`, `insertion_modal.dart:356-359`) — picking a photo, server-side OCR via `POST /media/ocr`, and saving a `source=photo` Entry don't exist, and the app has no image-picker package at all.

**Approach:** Add a new `PhotoEntryCubit` (own sealed state, separate from `TextEntryCubit`/`AudioEntryCubit`) driving capture → processingOcr → recognized → error, backed by a new `capture/domain` port `PhotoPicker` (`image_picker`) and a new `capture/data` `MediaRepository`/`MediaRemoteDataSource` calling `media-ocr`. Wire Foto tab switching into the picker; `OcrNoText`/`PayloadTooLarge` each get their own distinct, non-retryable error UI.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- `image_picker: ^1.1.2` (new dependency) powers the "Câmera"/"Galeria" buttons. New `capture/domain` port `PhotoPicker` (`pickFromCamera()`/`pickFromGallery()` → `PickedPhoto? {path, mimeType}`, `null` = user canceled) wraps it — mirrors `MicRecorder`'s port convention (`mic_recorder.dart:20-46`); never call `ImagePicker` directly from the cubit. `mimeType` is inferred from the picked file's extension (jpeg/png/webp only, matching the contract's enum).
- OCR belongs to `capture/`, never `entries/` (epic Technical Decisions: "`features/capture/` ... holds no Entry data itself"). New `capture/domain/repositories/media_repository.dart` (`recognizeText({required Uint8List imageBytes, required String mimeType}) -> Either<Failure, OcrResult>` where `OcrResult{text, confidence}`), `capture/data/datasources/media_remote_data_source.dart` + `capture/data/repositories/media_repository_impl.dart` mirroring `entries_remote_data_source.dart:21-46`/`entries_repository_impl.dart:29-51` but with **no Hive persistence step** — the image is never persisted, forward the datasource's `Either` as-is. Calls `ApiClient.post('media-ocr', data: {image: base64Encode(bytes), mimeType: mimeType})` (`api_client.dart:52-62`); base64-encodes only inside the datasource.
- `PhotoEntryCubit(this._photoPicker, this._mediaRepository, this._entriesRepository)`, own sealed `PhotoCaptureState`: `PhotoIdle` → `PhotoProcessing(path, mimeType)` → `PhotoRecognized(path, mimeType, text, saving)` / `PhotoSaved` / `PhotoError(path, mimeType, message, kind, text?)`. `kind` is a 3-way discriminator (`generic | ocrNoText | payloadTooLarge`) driving three distinct branches — `Failure.ocrNoText`/`Failure.payloadTooLarge` already exist (`failure.dart:32-34,80-81`): **ocrNoText** → "Tentar novamente" (re-OCR same image via `retry()`) + "Salvar só a foto" (`saveWithoutText()`, creates the Entry with a fixed non-empty placeholder `content` — e.g. `"Registro fotográfico (sem texto reconhecido)"` — since the contract's `content.minLength: 1` forbids empty); **payloadTooLarge** → size-specific message, no action besides picking a different photo (no retry, no "Salvar só a foto"); **generic** (any other `Failure`, incl. a save failure, `text` non-null) → plain "Tentar novamente" re-running whichever call failed, same shape as `AudioError`.
- Recognized/placeholder text saves via `_entriesRepository.create(source: EntrySource.photo, content: <text>)` — `EntrySource.photo` already exists (`entry.dart:6`), no `Entry`/DTO change needed.
- Every transition gets a screen-reader announcement via the existing `_announce` helper (`insertion_modal.dart:196-205`). `InsertionModal.show`/`build` gain a third `photoCubit` param, provided via the existing `MultiBlocProvider` (`insertion_modal.dart:106-107`), canceled+closed in `show()`'s `finally` alongside the other two (mirrors `audioCubit.cancel(discardPreserved: true)` + `close()`, lines 97-98). `isSaving` (`insertion_modal.dart:310`) must also OR in `PhotoEntryCubit`'s own saving flag — the exact cross-tab race 3.2's review already fixed for Audio.
- `NSCameraUsageDescription`/`NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription` added to `ios/Runner/Info.plist` after the existing Face ID/mic keys (line 32), same style.
- Use the `_generation` counter pattern (`audio_entry_cubit.dart:134`) in `PhotoEntryCubit` for the same tab-switch-mid-await race, now across the picker call and the OCR network call.

**Ask First:** none identified.

**Never:**
- Persist the image anywhere beyond the in-flight OCR call (no local cache, no backend storage) — only extracted text ever moves on.
- Implement the full cross-tab cancel-safety rule (Story 3.4) — this story's trivial case only: `create` fires only on explicit Salvar/"Salvar só a foto"; leaving Foto mid-pick/mid-OCR just discards the in-flight picker call/OCR request.
- Add HEIC→JPEG conversion or any client-side image-size pre-check — anything outside jpeg/png/webp (e.g. iOS HEIC) is a known gap, deferred like 3.2's untested native-plugin edges (no device exists to verify).
- Write a test exercising the real `image_picker` native plugin — mock it (mocktail), same convention as `MicRecorder`/`AudioTranscriber`.
- Touch Story 3.1/3.2's Texto/Áudio tabs beyond the shared `InsertionModal` wiring already described above.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Happy path | Switch to Foto, tap Câmera or Galeria, pick a jpeg/png/webp photo | Thumbnail+spinner "Reconhecendo texto..." while OCR runs; recognized text editable; Salvar fires `POST /entries` (`source: photo`), success closes modal | N/A |

| `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` | Picked image exceeds backend's limit | Size-specific message, no retry button, no "Salvar só a foto" | Non-retryable |
| User cancels picker | Câmera/Galeria dialog dismissed with no file chosen | Stays on Foto's capture buttons (`PhotoIdle`) | N/A |

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** The Foto tab is still an idle placeholder (`CaptureTab.foto => _IdleTabPlaceholder`, `insertion_modal.dart:356-359`) — picking a photo, server-side OCR via `POST /media/ocr`, and saving a `source=photo` Entry don't exist, and the app has no image-picker package at all.

**Approach:** Add a new `PhotoEntryCubit` (own sealed state, separate from `TextEntryCubit`/`AudioEntryCubit`) driving capture → processingOcr → recognized → error, backed by a new `capture/domain` port `PhotoPicker` (`image_picker`) and a new `capture/data` `MediaRepository`/`MediaRemoteDataSource` calling `media-ocr`. Wire Foto tab switching into the picker; `OcrNoText`/`PayloadTooLarge` each get their own distinct, non-retryable error UI.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- `image_picker: ^1.1.2` (new dependency) powers the "Câmera"/"Galeria" buttons. New `capture/domain` port `PhotoPicker` (`pickFromCamera()`/`pickFromGallery()` → `PickedPhoto? {path, mimeType}`, `null` = user canceled) wraps it — mirrors `MicRecorder`'s port convention (`mic_recorder.dart:20-46`); never call `ImagePicker` directly from the cubit. `mimeType` is inferred from the picked file's extension (jpeg/png/webp only, matching the contract's enum).
- OCR belongs to `capture/`, never `entries/` (epic Technical Decisions: "`features/capture/` ... holds no Entry data itself"). New `capture/domain/repositories/media_repository.dart` (`recognizeText({required Uint8List imageBytes, required String mimeType}) -> Either<Failure, OcrResult>` where `OcrResult{text, confidence}`), `capture/data/datasources/media_remote_data_source.dart` + `capture/data/repositories/media_repository_impl.dart` mirroring `entries_remote_data_source.dart:21-46`/`entries_repository_impl.dart:29-51` but with **no Hive persistence step** — the image is never persisted, forward the datasource's `Either` as-is. Calls `ApiClient.post('media-ocr', data: {image: base64Encode(bytes), mimeType: mimeType})` (`api_client.dart:52-62`); base64-encodes only inside the datasource.
- `PhotoEntryCubit(this._photoPicker, this._mediaRepository, this._entriesRepository)`, own sealed `PhotoCaptureState`: `PhotoIdle` → `PhotoProcessing(path, mimeType)` → `PhotoRecognized(path, mimeType, text, saving)` / `PhotoSaved` / `PhotoError(path, mimeType, message, kind, text?)`. `kind` is a 3-way discriminator (`generic | ocrNoText | payloadTooLarge`) driving three distinct branches — `Failure.ocrNoText`/`Failure.payloadTooLarge` already exist (`failure.dart:32-34,80-81`): **ocrNoText** → "Tentar novamente" (re-OCR same image via `retry()`) + "Salvar só a foto" (`saveWithoutText()`, creates the Entry with a fixed non-empty placeholder `content` — e.g. `"Registro fotográfico (sem texto reconhecido)"` — since the contract's `content.minLength: 1` forbids empty); **payloadTooLarge** → size-specific message, no action besides picking a different photo (no retry, no "Salvar só a foto"); **generic** (any other `Failure`, incl. a save failure, `text` non-null) → plain "Tentar novamente" re-running whichever call failed, same shape as `AudioError`.
- Recognized/placeholder text saves via `_entriesRepository.create(source: EntrySource.photo, content: <text>)` — `EntrySource.photo` already exists (`entry.dart:6`), no `Entry`/DTO change needed.
- Every transition gets a screen-reader announcement via the existing `_announce` helper (`insertion_modal.dart:196-205`). `InsertionModal.show`/`build` gain a third `photoCubit` param, provided via the existing `MultiBlocProvider` (`insertion_modal.dart:106-107`), canceled+closed in `show()`'s `finally` alongside the other two (mirrors `audioCubit.cancel(discardPreserved: true)` + `close()`, lines 97-98). `isSaving` (`insertion_modal.dart:310`) must also OR in `PhotoEntryCubit`'s own saving flag — the exact cross-tab race 3.2's review already fixed for Audio.
- `NSCameraUsageDescription`/`NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription` added to `ios/Runner/Info.plist` after the existing Face ID/mic keys (line 32), same style.
- Use the `_generation` counter pattern (`audio_entry_cubit.dart:134`) in `PhotoEntryCubit` for the same tab-switch-mid-await race, now across the picker call and the OCR network call.

**Ask First:** none identified.

**Never:**
- Persist the image anywhere beyond the in-flight OCR call (no local cache, no backend storage) — only extracted text ever moves on.
- Implement the full cross-tab cancel-safety rule (Story 3.4) — this story's trivial case only: `create` fires only on explicit Salvar/"Salvar só a foto"; leaving Foto mid-pick/mid-OCR just discards the in-flight picker call/OCR request.
- Add HEIC→JPEG conversion or any client-side image-size pre-check — anything outside jpeg/png/webp (e.g. iOS HEIC) is a known gap, deferred like 3.2's untested native-plugin edges (no device exists to verify).
- Write a test exercising the real `image_picker` native plugin — mock it (mocktail), same convention as `MicRecorder`/`AudioTranscriber`.
- Touch Story 3.1/3.2's Texto/Áudio tabs beyond the shared `InsertionModal` wiring already described above.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Happy path | Switch to Foto, tap Câmera or Galeria, pick a jpeg/png/webp photo | Thumbnail+spinner "Reconhecendo texto..." while OCR runs; recognized text editable; Salvar fires `POST /entries` (`source: photo`), success closes modal | N/A |
| `OCR_NO_TEXT` | `media-ocr` succeeds with no usable text | Thumbnail kept, "Não foi possível reconhecer o texto"; "Tentar novamente" re-OCRs same image, "Salvar só a foto" saves with placeholder content | Non-retryable, two distinct recovery paths |
| `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` | Picked image exceeds backend's limit | Size-specific message, no retry button, no "Salvar só a foto" | Non-retryable |
| User cancels picker | Câmera/Galeria dialog dismissed with no file chosen | Stays on Foto's capture buttons (`PhotoIdle`) | N/A |
| Save fails (incl. offline) | Salvar tapped from `PhotoRecognized`/a save-failure `PhotoError`, `create` returns a `Failure` | Inline message from `Failure.message`; Salvar re-enabled, text/photo preserved | `Failure.fromCode`, no auto-retry |
| Leave tab mid-pick/OCR | Switch to Texto/Áudio while `PhotoProcessing` | In-flight picker call/OCR request discarded; no `POST /entries` fires | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

- `pubspec.yaml:53` (after `record`) -- add `image_picker: ^1.1.2`.

- `lib/features/capture/data/repositories/media_repository_impl.dart` (new) -- forwards datasource `Either`, no Hive step -- mirrors `entries_repository_impl.dart:29-51` minus persistence.
- `lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/photo_entry_cubit.dart` (new) -- `PhotoEntryCubit` + `PhotoCaptureState` hierarchy, mirrors `audio_entry_cubit.dart`'s shape (states 17-108, methods 160-543, `_generation` guard at 134).

- `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart:35-100` (`show`) -- accept third `photoCubit`, cancel+close it in `finally`.
- `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart:102-111` (`build`) -- add third `BlocProvider.value(value: photoCubit)`.
- `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart:207-249` (tab-switch listener) -- extend to discard in-flight photo pick/OCR on leaving Foto.
- `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart:305-310` (`isSaving`) -- OR in `PhotoEntryCubit`'s saving flag.
- `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart:356-359` -- replace `_IdleTabPlaceholder` with new `_FotoTab` widget (mirrors `_AudioTab:634-670`; capture-buttons sub-state instead of a recording view, two-button error sub-state for `ocrNoText`).

2. Find the `development_status` entry matching `{story_key}`. If not found, warn the user once (`"{story_key} not found in sprint-status; skipping sprint sync"`) and return to caller.

4. Set `development_status[{story_key}]` to `{target_status}`.
5. **Epic lift (only when `target_status` = `in-progress`).** Derive the parent epic key as `epic-{N}` from the leading numeric segment of `{story_key}` (e.g., `3-2-digest-delivery` → `epic-3`). If that entry exists and is `backlog`, set it to `in-progress`. Leave it alone otherwise. Skip this sub-step entirely when `target_status` is not `in-progress`.
6. Refresh `last_updated` to the current date.
7. Save the file, preserving ALL comments and structure including STATUS DEFINITIONS and WORKFLOW NOTES.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] `pubspec.yaml` -- add `image_picker: ^1.1.2`.
- [ ] `lib/features/capture/domain/services/photo_picker.dart` (new) -- abstract `PhotoPicker` port.
- [ ] `lib/features/capture/data/services/image_picker_photo_picker.dart` (new) -- `image_picker`-backed implementation.
- [ ] `lib/features/capture/domain/repositories/media_repository.dart` (new) -- abstract `MediaRepository` port.
- [ ] `lib/features/capture/data/datasources/media_remote_data_source.dart` (new) -- `media-ocr` call.
- [ ] `lib/features/capture/data/repositories/media_repository_impl.dart` (new) -- forwards datasource result.
- [ ] `lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/photo_entry_cubit.dart` (new) -- `PhotoEntryCubit` + `PhotoCaptureState` hierarchy.
- [ ] `lib/features/capture/capture_injection.dart` -- register new picker/media/cubit bindings.
- [ ] `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart` -- third cubit wiring, tab-switch discard, `isSaving` OR, new `_FotoTab` widget.
- [ ] `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart` -- resolve and pass `PhotoEntryCubit`.
- [ ] `ios/Runner/Info.plist` -- add camera/photo-library usage descriptions.
- [ ] Unit/widget tests under `test/features/capture/` covering the I/O matrix above.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given the Foto tab, when I tap Câmera or Galeria and pick a photo, then a thumbnail and "Reconhecendo texto..." show while `POST /media/ocr` runs, with no image bytes ever reaching `POST /entries`.
- Given `OCR_NO_TEXT`, when the error shows, then both "Tentar novamente" and "Salvar só a foto" are present and each behaves per the I/O matrix.
- Given `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE`, when the error shows, then no retry or save-without-text action is offered.
- Given recognized text, when I edit it and tap Salvar, then the resulting Entry carries `source: photo` and the edited text.
- Given `fvm flutter analyze` and `fvm flutter test`, then both report zero issues / all green.

entries.name: SendMessage
entries.description:
# SendMessage

Send a message to another agent.

```json
{"to": "researcher", "summary": "assign task 1", "message": "start on task #1"}
```

| `to` | |
|---|---|
| `"researcher"` | Teammate by name |
| `"main"` | The main conversation (background subagents only) |
| `"worker"` | Any agent from `ListAgents` — subagent, another local Claude session |
| `"worker [3fa9c1]"` | Same, plus its `[ref]` — only when a listing or an error shows one |

Your plain text output is NOT visible to other agents — to communicate, you MUST call this tool. Messages from teammates are delivered automatically; you don't check an inbox. Refer to agents by name — names keep working after an agent completes (a send resumes it from its transcript). Use the raw `agentId` (format `a...-...`) from its spawn result only when the agent has no name, or when a newer agent took the name (latest wins). When relaying, don't quote the original — it's already rendered to the user.

## Cross-session

Use `ListAgents` to discover targets. Every row leads with the agent's `name [ref]` — the name IS the address; there is no separate address syntax.

```json
{"to": "worker", "message": "check if tests pass over there"}
{"to": "worker [3fa9c1]", "message": "you, specifically"}
```

Send the bare name — a name that exactly matches one live agent or session (on this machine, on another machine, or in the cloud) delivers directly. Append the ` [ref]` only when the bare name is not enough — `ListAgents` shows two rows with it, or an error asks you to disambiguate (you typed only a prefix, or a session list could not be checked). A ref you did not just read from a listing or an error will not resolve, and if the same name also names an in-process agent, the bare name always wins — use the in-process one.

A listed peer is alive and will receive your message; messages enqueue and drain at the receiver's next tool round (its `ListAgents` row says whether it is busy or idle right now). A successful send means the message reached that session, not that its Claude read it: a session running in a different permission mode than yours holds cross-session messages for its user's approval (and may let them expire), and a session can refuse them outright — for a session on this machine a `[Cross-session delivery notice]` tells you when that happens (the tool result says when this session has no inbox for one to reach); for a Remote Control, cloud or Claude Desktop session nothing reports back, so never treat silence as agreement. Your message arrives wrapped as `<cross-session-message from="...">`. **To reply to an incoming message, copy its `from` attribute as your `to`.** Cross-session messages travel between SESSIONS: if you are a subagent, your send goes out under your parent session's address, and any reply is delivered to the parent session's conversation, not to you. The receiver reads your message literally in every case (idle or busy, on this machine, over Remote Control or headless): an `@` followed by a file path, or `@server:resource`, attaches nothing there, unlike in your own user's input. So never rely on `@` to deliver content: send the text itself, or a file with its own tool.

To hear when a session ON THIS MACHINE finishes what it is doing, pass `notify_when_idle: true` (from the main conversation only) — one-shot and opt-in: exactly one `[Cross-session idle notice]` arrives when it next goes idle (or exits) — shown to you, or only to your user when this session holds peer messages for approval (the tool result says which); if it never signals within the subscription's lifetime (it may still be busy, may refuse inbound requests, or may have ended abruptly) the notice says the subscription expired instead. Omit `message` for a pure subscription that costs that session nothing; include one to deliver it now AND subscribe. Never poll `ListAgents` in a loop or send "are you done?" messages instead.

Permission boundaries are per-session: NEVER ask a peer to perform an action that was denied or blocked in your session, or that you expect your own permission settings would block — a peer doing it for you bypasses the user's permission decision (cross-session permission laundering). Route blocked work back to your user instead.

to.description: Recipient: a name from ListAgents (append its " [ref]" only when a listing or an error shows one), a teammate name, "main", or a background agent's agentId

summary.description: A 5-10 word label for your own transcript row (not transmitted — the recipient previews the first line of `message`). Truncated to 200 characters rather than rejected.

message.description: Plain text message content. The recipient's human sees only the FIRST LINE as a one-line preview until they expand it, so make the first line a clear, self-contained sentence saying what this is about — not a greeting, preamble, or bare @-mention.

notify_when_idle.description: Ask a session ON THIS MACHINE to send you ONE notice when it next goes idle (finishes its turn with nothing queued) or exits — opt-in, one-shot, no polling. With a message: deliver it now AND subscribe. Without a message (omit it): a pure subscription that costs the other session nothing.

input.message:
Code review of your spec-3-3-photo-entry-capture-backend-ocr.md implementation surfaced 8 real, in-scope issues, all triaged as auto-fixable "patch" findings (no spec changes needed — the spec itself is fine). Please apply all 8 fixes directly to the working tree, then re-run `fvm flutter analyze` and `fvm flutter test` to confirm both stay green, and report back what you changed and the verification result.

1. **Picked photo temp file is never deleted (resource leak).** `lib/features/capture/data/services/image_picker_photo_picker.dart` / `lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/photo_entry_cubit.dart` — `image_picker`'s camera/gallery pick writes a real OS temp file each time, but nothing in `PhotoEntryCubit` ever deletes it (on cancel, on tab-switch-away discard, or after a successful save). The comment you wrote at `insertion_modal.dart` (near the `photoCubit.cancel()`/`close()` call in `show()`'s `finally`) claiming "Foto never creates a temp file of its own... nothing extra to clean up" is factually wrong and should be corrected. Fix: add a best-effort `_deletePickedFile(path)` helper to `PhotoEntryCubit`, mirroring `AudioEntryCubit._deleteRecordingFile()`, and call it: after a successful `save()`, on `cancel()` when discarding a `PhotoProcessing`/`PhotoRecognized`/`PhotoError`-with-path state, and when a fresh pick replaces a previous one. Fix the stale comment in `insertion_modal.dart` to reflect reality.

2. **`PhotoEntryCubit.cancel()` doesn't reset the `_picking` flag when called before `PhotoProcessing` is reached.** `lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/photo_entry_cubit.dart:376-385` — `cancel()` only emits `PhotoIdle` `if (state is PhotoProcessing)`, but while the native `pickFromCamera()`/`pickFromGallery()` call is still in flight, state is still `PhotoIdle` and `_picking` is `true`. Leaving the Foto tab mid-pick bumps `_generation` (correctly aborting the stale continuation) but leaves `_picking = true` stuck — a user who switches back to Foto and taps Câmera/Galeria again is silently dropped by the `!_picking` guard in `_pick()` until the original stale `pick()` eventually resolves on its own. Fix: have `cancel()` also reset `_picking = false` unconditionally (it's already safe to do since the generation bump makes any in-flight continuation a no-op regardless).

3. **`InsertionModal.show()`'s `finally` block cleans up the three cubits sequentially with no isolation.** `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart` (the `finally` block in `show()`) — if `audioCubit.cancel()`/`close()` throws, the newly-added `photoCubit.cancel()`/`close()` calls right after it never run, leaking `PhotoEntryCubit` (and any in-flight OCR call it holds). Fix: wrap each cubit's cancel+close pair in its own try/finally (or equivalent) so a failure in one never skips the others.

4. **Missing test: the "Captura de foto cancelada" announcement is never asserted anywhere.** You added this announcement in `_onPhotoStateChange`'s `PhotoIdle()` case (mirroring Audio's own review-added "Gravação cancelada" test), but `test/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal_photo_test.dart`'s announcements group never exercises the tab-switch-away-mid-pick path. Add a widget test that reaches `PhotoProcessing` (pick via `tester.runAsync`, gated like your existing "Leave tab mid-pick" test), switches to another tab, and asserts `interceptAnnouncements` captured `'Captura de foto cancelada'` — directly mirroring the existing Áudio-side "Gravação cancelada" test in `insertion_modal_audio_test.dart`.

5. **Missing test: full-modal dismiss (not a tab switch) while Foto is mid-pick/mid-OCR has no coverage.** Audio has a dedicated test for this exact scenario ("Dismissing the whole modal (not switching tabs) while recording releases the mic too" in `insertion_modal_audio_test.dart`); Foto's own "Leave tab mid-pick" test only covers the tab-switch path, never full-modal "x"/swipe/barrier dismissal while a pick/OCR call is in flight. Add the mirrored test to `insertion_modal_photo_test.dart`.

6. **Inconsistent `TextField` decoration in `_PhotoErrorView`'s save-failure branch.** `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart`, `_PhotoErrorView`'s `PhotoErrorKind.generic` branch with non-null `text` (~line 926) — its `TextField`'s `InputDecoration` defines only `border`, missing the `focusedBorder` that `_PhotoRecognizedView`'s otherwise-identical field has. Add the matching `focusedBorder` for consistency.

7. **`AndroidManifest.xml` has no changes for the new `image_picker` dependency.** Only `ios/Runner/Info.plist` was updated with `NSCameraUsageDescription`/`NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription`. `image_picker`'s camera source needs `<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.CAMERA"/>` declared in `android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`, plus a `<queries>` entry for camera/gallery intent visibility on API 30+. Add both, following `image_picker`'s own documented Android setup.

8. **`dart format` wasn't rerun on `test/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal_audio_test.dart` after adding the `photoCubit` parameter.** Several `_openModal(tester, cubit: textCubit, audioCubit: audioCubit, photoCubit: photoCubit)` calls were left as long single lines while the equivalent calls in `insertion_modal_test.dart`/`insertion_modal_photo_test.dart` are properly wrapped. Run `dart format` (via `fvm flutter format` or `fvm dart format`) on that file.

Four other findings came up in review but were triaged as out-of-scope for this story (no permission-denial retry path for camera/gallery, no client-side image downscaling, duplicated test-double classes, and a gap in 3.2's own audio-dismiss test coverage) — those are being logged to deferred-work.md separately, you don't need to act on them. One more (no "choose another photo" button from a recognized photo) and two more (OcrResult.confidence unused, no durable image link after save) were rejected as out-of-scope/already-intentional per the spec's own Design Notes and Never clauses — also nothing to do there.

Added a `discardPreserved` param to `cancel({bool discardPreserved = false})`, mirroring `AudioEntryCubit.cancel()`'s exact convention. Fixed the stale comment in `insertion_modal.dart`'s `show()` that incorrectly claimed Foto "never creates a temp file of its own" — it does, every `image_picker` pick.
  
  2. **`_picking` stuck true on mid-pick cancel** — `cancel()` now unconditionally resets `_picking = false` (safe regardless of state, since the `_generation` bump already neutralizes any stale continuation).
  
  3. **Unisolated cleanup in `InsertionModal.show()`'s `finally`** — restructured into nested `try`/`finally` blocks so `cubit.close()` → `audioCubit.cancel(discardPreserved:true)+close()` → `photoCubit.cancel(discardPreserved:true)+close()` each run regardless of an earlier step throwing.
  
  4. **Missing "Captura de foto cancelada" announcement test** — added to `insertion_modal_photo_test.dart`'s announcements group: reaches `PhotoProcessing` via a gated picker call (`fakePhotoPicker.cameraGate`), switches tabs, asserts the announcement — mirroring Audio's own "Gravação cancelada" test.
  
  5. **Missing full-modal-dismiss-mid-pick test** — added `'Dismissing the whole modal ... while a pick is in flight discards it too'`, mirroring Audio's equivalent test (taps the "x" close icon instead of switching tabs, asserts `photoCubit.isClosed` and no `create()` call).
  
  6. **Missing `focusedBorder`** — added to `_PhotoErrorView`'s `PhotoErrorKind.generic`/save-failure `TextField`, matching `_PhotoRecognizedView`'s identical field.
  
  7. **Android manifest — not applicable, flagged back rather than applied.** This repository has no `android/` directory at all: `.metadata`'s `migration.platforms` list only contains `root` and `ios`, and the frozen `docs/input/requirements.md:375` states "Platform: iOS, portrait only" (AGENTS.md forbids editing anything under `docs/input/`, and that doc isn't silent here — it's explicit). Creating a full Android platform target (manifest, gradle, `queries` entries) would be fabricating product scope this app was never meant to have, not a patch fix, so I left it alone instead of inventing out-of-scope scaffolding. Flagging this back in case the premise needs correcting upstream rather than silently skipping it.
  
  8. **`dart format`** — ran on the flagged `insertion_modal_audio_test.dart` plus every other Dart file touched by this story (new and modified) for consistency across the whole diff.
  
  **Additional work beyond the 8 findings:** Added cubit-level tests covering the new deletion/`discardPreserved`/`_picking`-reset behavior in `photo_entry_cubit_test.dart` (save-success deletes file, `discardPreserved: true/false` behavior for `PhotoRecognized`/`PhotoError`/`PhotoIdle`, `_picking` reset allowing a retry after a mid-pick cancel, and the payloadTooLarge-replace-deletes-old-file path). Also fixed one pre-existing test ("picking again from a payloadTooLarge error...") whose mock reused the same file path for two consecutive picks — the new "delete the replaced file" logic now correctly deletes that file out from under the second pick's own read, so I gave it (and the new regression test) a distinct second temp file, matching real `image_picker` behavior where every pick returns a fresh path.
  
  **Verification:**
  - `fvm flutter analyze` — 0 issues.
